exercises.name: Glute Kickback Machine
exercises.precautions: One knee stays on the support pad, hands gripping the handles;Hips stay square - no twisting as you lift;Lift by squeezing your glute - not by arching your lower back;Raise the free leg rearward and return slowly

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.precautions: Hold a chair back or wall with one hand;Moving leg straight, toes pointing forward - not turned out;Lift the leg out to the side only 30-45 degrees;Stand tall - do not lean away from the moving leg
exercises.cues: Hold support, stand tall;Leg out to the side, toes forward;Lower slowly, repeat, switch

exercises.name: Supine Leg Open-Close
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, legs up toward the ceiling;Open legs wide, then close slowly - control both ways;Lower back stays gently on the surface;Keep the movement smooth, no dropping
exercises.cues: Legs up;Open wide, close slow;Back stays down

exercises.name: Supine Butterfly
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, soles of the feet together;Let knees fall open, then draw them back together slowly;Never press the knees down with your hands;Keep breathing slow and easy
exercises.cues: Soles together;Knees open and close gently;Breathe slow

exercises.name: Baddha Konasana (Butterfly Pose)
exercises.precautions: Sit tall, soles together, knees open;Hold feet and gently flutter or rest the knees open;Never force knees to the floor;Sit on a folded blanket if hips feel tight
exercises.cues: Soles together, sit tall;Knees open gently;Breathe slow

exercises.name: Chair-Supported Leg Raises
exercises.precautions: Stand behind a chair, hands resting on its back;Raise one leg out to the side, then behind you, under control;Keep the torso tall and still - the leg does the work;Never swing or lean away
exercises.cues: Hold the chair, stand tall;Leg out to the side, then back;Torso stays still

exercises.name: Hip Turnovers (Muay Thai)
exercises.precautions: On all fours or standing tall, rotate the hip open and over like stepping over a low hurdle;Move one leg at a time, under control;Keep the supporting leg soft;Smooth beats fast while learning
exercises.cues: Lift the knee, turn the hip over;Smooth controlled arcs;Alternate sides

exercises.name: DB Swing
exercises.precautions: Hold one dumbbell (or two) by the ends, hinge with a flat back;Snap the hips forward to float the weight to chest height - arms are just ropes;Never lift with your shoulders or lean back;Let the weight fall back into the hinge
exercises.cues: Hinge, snap the hips;Weight floats to chest height;Arms are ropes

steps.dont: Hold one dumbbell (or two) by the ends, hinge with a flat back

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.precautions: Wide stance; shift your hips fully onto one leg into a deep side squat;The straight leg's toes point up, heel down;Keep the bent knee tracking over its toes;Use your hands on the floor for balance while learning
exercises.cues: Shift fully to one side;Straight leg toes up;Sit deep, chest up

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
exercises.precautions: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one behind;Rotate both knees together to the other side like windshield wipers;Keep your chest tall and hands off the floor if you can;Move slowly - range grows over weeks, not minutes

exercises.name: 90/90 Folds
exercises.precautions: From the 90/90 position, hinge your chest over the front shin;Keep the back long as you fold;Only fold as far as the front hip allows;Return tall before switching sides
exercises.cues: Sit in 90/90;Fold over the front shin;Long back, slow return

exercises.name: Seated Frog Rotations
exercises.precautions: Sit tall on a chair, feet wide, knees bent;Let both knees roll in and out together in small arcs;Keep feet planted and torso tall;Small, gentle range - this is mobility, not stretching to pain
exercises.cues: Sit tall, feet wide;Roll knees in and out gently;Small smooth arcs

exercises.name: Seated Frog Twist & Reach
exercises.precautions: From the seated frog position, rotate your torso and reach one arm across and up;Keep both sit bones on the chair;Reach tall rather than far;Alternate sides smoothly
exercises.cues: Twist and reach tall;Sit bones stay down;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Knee Stirs (Supine)
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back, one knee bent with the foot held or resting;Stir the bent leg in slow circles from the hip;Keep your pelvis still and lower back down;Reverse direction, then switch legs

exercises.name: 90/90 Lift-Offs
exercises.precautions: From the 90/90 position, lift the back knee off the floor using only the hip;Keep the torso tall and still - no leaning away;Small lift is fine, this is end-range strength;Lower slowly, no dropping

exercises.name: Hip Circles (All Fours)
exercises.precautions: On all fours, lift one knee out to the side;Draw the biggest slow circle you can with that knee;Keep your back flat and pelvis level;Reverse direction halfway, then switch legs
exercises.cues: All fours, knee lifted;Draw big slow circles;Back stays flat

exercises.name: Frog Rocks
exercises.precautions: On all fours with knees wide and feet turned out;Rock your hips slowly back toward your heels, then forward;Keep the range comfortable - inner thighs set the limit;Never bounce at the end range
exercises.cues: Knees wide, feet out;Rock hips back and forth slowly;Comfortable range only

exercises.name: Full Lotus Forward Fold

exercises.name: Runner's Lunge Rotations

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Bench)

exercises.name: Hip Rotations

stretches.name: Pigeon Pose
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
